titleBack: And Now You'll Give It To Me

flipToBack.prose: Flip if your First Order characters CONTROL two battlegrounds (controlsWith: control + at least one First Order character there) AND no Resistance Agent is present at a battleground site.

children.req: controlsWith: control 2 battlegrounds with actor there
canSpot: Resistance Agent present at a battleground site

flipToFront.prose: Flips back if you do NOT OCCUPY two battlegrounds (plain occupy - First Order characters NOT required to hold) OR a Resistance Agent IS present at a battleground site.

children.req: canSpot: Resistance Agent present at a battleground site

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: CONTROL-with (2 battlegrounds, any type - sites or systems - with a First Order character there) + negative presence check (no Resistance Agent presentAt battleground SITE)
flipToFront: plain OCCUPY (2 battlegrounds, no character-type requirement) OR positive Resistance-Agent presence; asymmetric - holding the back is easier than flipping (occupy vs control-with-FO)

Resistance Agent identity is a chosen-state: opponent's revealed unique non-Luke/non-Jedi character with ability gains Keyword.RESISTANCE_AGENT via KeywordModifier on Filters.sameTitle(revealed); otherwise Luke is the agent (and loses immunity to attrition)
typedIdentities: Filters.battleground (both laws; NOT battleground_site-only), Filters.battleground_site (agent presence leaf)
Filters.Tuanul_Village; Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_VII, Filters.location, Filters.not(Filters.Tuanul_Village)); Filters.I_Will_Finish_What_You_Started (setup deploys)

opponent agent-reveal filter: Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.unique, Filters.hasAbility, Filters.character, Filters.except(Filters.or(Filters.Luke, Filters.Jedi))), Filters.mayBeRevealedAsResistanceAgent)
Filters.and(Filters.Dark_Jedi, Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_VII)) (auto-lost); Title.Set_For_Stun immunity for agents

Filters.First_Order_leader (back destiny tax); Filters.BB8_or_has_BB8_as_permanent_astromech (retrieval-cancel exception); Filters.Kylo (back Interrupt engine); Filters.Interrupt stacked on I_Will_Finish_What_You_Started
setupAndPullRoutes: On deploy: deploy Tuanul Village, any other [Episode VII] location, and I Will Finish What You Started from Reserve Deck [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057.java:58-78]

On deploy (optional, OPPONENT): reveal one unique character with ability (except Luke or a Jedi, or mayBeRevealedAsResistanceAgent) from opponent's Reserve Deck as Resistance Agent; if declined, Luke is the agent and loses immunity to attrition [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057.java:79-124]

No ongoing Reserve Deck pulls on either side; back engine instead stacks Interrupts from Lost Pile on I Will Finish What You Started (once/turn if Kylo on table) and plays one stacked Interrupt per turn as if from hand (then out of play) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057_BACK.java:174-297]
otherObligations: Remainder of game: non-[Episode VII] Dark Jedi are LOST (required proxy trigger on isTableChanged) - deck-construction constraint Rando must respect [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057.java:125-151]
Remainder of game: Resistance Agents immune to Set For Stun [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057.java:152-155]

Back: where you have a First Order leader in battle, opponent must use or lose 1 Force to draw each battle destiny card (else draw fails) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057_BACK.java:77-137]
Back: unless BB-8 on table, opponent's Force retrieval is canceled (required) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057_BACK.java:139-151]

Back Kylo engine: stack Interrupt from Lost Pile on I Will Finish What You Started once/turn; play a stacked Interrupt once/turn as if from hand, then out of play [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set208/dark/Card208_057_BACK.java:174-297]
